body:
## Summary

Add a Qwen3-TTS 0.6B CustomVoice streaming Node to the existing Graph Editor, backed by an extension-owned local Worker and pinned, reviewed browser assets. Deliver incremental PCM through an explicit producer-independent typed port to Speaker.

**Draft / partial implementation of #168:** Qwen3-TTS has real local MV3 streaming evidence. CosyVoice3 remains unsupported and absent from the palette/runtime: its reviewed browser export finalizes whole utterances. The remaining CosyVoice3 export/runtime implementation and real-model verification are preserved in [Task #172](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/172), as permitted by requirement 6 and the parent's tracking update. Review all of #168's original bounded acceptance before merge; the allowed split needs no additional Qwen-only scope approval.

## Outcome

- English and Japanese PCM begins rendering before synthesis completes in the recorded real-model runs. Committed text is processed as ordered utterances; provisional text is rejected.
- Speaker validates stream identity, sequence and boundaries, schedules chunks continuously, resamples native rates and bounds accepted audio. Stop drains accepted work; Cancel halts generation/playback and suppresses late replies.
- Save/Models explicitly prepares hash-pinned assets; Start uses cached assets only. Existing MV3 CSP, diagnostics and activation from the Start gesture are retained.
- Existing Supertonic3, Kokoro, completed-clip Speaker and manual Audio player/WAV paths remain intact. Saved graphs need no new migration.
- Separate candidate conclusions, tokenizer/vocoder/runtime pins, licenses and resource limits are recorded in [streaming TTS documentation](docs/streaming-tts.md).

## Validation

The [evidence report](docs/evidence/streaming-tts-168.md) maps every original bounded acceptance criterion to the implementation and checks.

After merging current main at `7c4442d1bb5cad2cf15ab619b38be9c5c0870efc`:

- 749 unit tests passed, including boundaries/order/replay, bounded queues, overflow followed by abort, Stop/Cancel, late replies, graph persistence, preparation and cache failures.
- 1 controlled MV3 streaming test passed; 1 real decoder test was intentionally skipped. Controlled transport verifies playback/lifecycle, not real inference.
- 35 Chrome browser tests passed for Supertonic3/Kokoro, player/WAV, completed-clip Speaker, DOM display and translation ports, including main's provisional paired-text changes.
- TTS runtime preparation passed; staged Qwen runtime/tokenizer/notices sizes and hashes, model-manifest consistency and retained WAV/timing/decoder evidence were rechecked. PR artifact and whitespace checks passed.

Earlier implementation-stage results remain separate: 2 real-model packaged MV3 tests passed with pinned assets, covering decoder continuity and saved-graph English/Japanese streaming, consecutive utterances, Stop/Cancel and offline cache-only Start. First nonzero render versus synthesis EOS: English 1,966.45 vs 5,316.54 ms; Japanese 619.21 vs 5,324.40 ms. The full extension build also passed at that stage. The complete build and real-model tests were not rerun in this revision; pinned model weights are absent here.

Real-model evidence comes from one Apple M4 Max / 64 GiB machine running Chrome 156 with Metal WebGPU and a 48 kHz AudioContext. Browser rendering was measured; physical loudspeaker acoustics were not. Other hardware, minimum/peak memory, long sessions and GPU-loss recovery remain unqualified. Very short or queued utterances need not begin playback before their synthesis completes. No CosyVoice3 browser inference or pre-EOS playback is claimed.

**Required post-merge verification remains pending:** repeat packaged-extension checks from the merged commit with exact pins; record first-chunk/render/EOS timestamps, hardware and peak memory; verify both languages, consecutive utterances, Stop/Cancel and offline Start. Expect pre-completion audio, continuous ordered playback and no recording-time downloads. This PR does not establish production verification. Pending post-merge work remains separate from pre-merge approval under [the development flow](docs/development-flow.md).

## Related issues

Refs #168

CosyVoice3 implementation and verification: [Task #172](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/172), open and draft while its browser export/runtime blocker remains unresolved.

Keep this PR draft pending review of the parent's bounded acceptance. Keep #168 open until its acceptance and required post-merge verification are performed and recorded.

## Scope check

- [ ] This PR fully addresses each Issue it claims to resolve. Bounded acceptance review and required post-merge verification remain pending.
- [x] This PR does not include unrelated work.
- [x] This PR does not add speculative abstractions, extensibility, frameworks, or subsystems that are not needed by the Issue.
- [x] Any intentionally partial implementation is clearly stated, and the parent Issue is not presented as fully resolved unless the remaining scope has been explicitly split out. CosyVoice3 work is preserved in #172.
- [x] Validation maps to the Issue's expected outcome / acceptance criteria.
